blind_spots.blind_spot: Passive RF sensing is described entirely as a lab-characterization capability with no discussion of the RF interrogation link surviving a contested or EW-dense flightline/hangar environment.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A flight line or forward operating base is a contested RF/EW environment; an interrogation signal that works cleanly in a 12x12x24ft anechoic chamber can be jammed, attenuated, or crowded out by other emitters, and integrating the reader with existing GFE avionics data buses is nontrivial.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The team's proof point so far is chamber characterization and a single Air Force pilot, not a fielded, contested-spectrum deployment.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: RF reader queries sensor remotely without physical connection, enabling measurements during operation.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The newer Vision AI product line is marketed as 'completely contact-free' with zero mention of who calibrates, maintains, or retrains the vision model in the field.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Camera-based monitoring on a flightline or in a hangar means dust, vibration, variable lighting, and boresight drift that break a model trained on clean lab/demo footage; someone has to recalibrate it, and the site never names who that is or how.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Vision AI reads as a recent pivot/expansion beyond the core RF sensor business, still described at demo/marketing fidelity rather than field-operations fidelity.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Harness AI-powered video analysis to detect issues early, optimize performance, and protect your most critical systems—no sensors required.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Despite an active DoD customer relationship (AFLCMC) and a stated ambition to ship 'fully deployable products,' there is no mention anywhere in the site of ITAR/export control, CMMC, or ATO — all of which gate scaling a sensor/data company from an Air Force pilot into an actual program.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Engine health data and RF sensor design details are the kind of technical data ITAR and CMMC are built to control; without a compliance path already in motion, the Phase II-to-Phase III transition stalls on paperwork long after the engineering works.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: A 7-8 person team at seed stage is almost certainly still fully absorbed in R&D and chamber testing, not yet building out the compliance function a defense contract requires to scale.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: We specialize in bringing lab-proven innovations to market, turning early-stage R&D into fully deployable products.

opener_hook: Your AFLCMC customer called the wireless temperature sensor 'mission-ready' for engine health monitoring — has the RF interrogation link been characterized for a contested flightline, or just the anechoic chamber?
what_they_do: Battery-free passive RF sensors (plus a newer computer-vision product) for measuring temperature, strain, and vibration on rotating turbomachinery parts like turbine blades, piloted with the Air Force for engine health monitoring.
